scope: Candidates 21-30 of frozen P0 manifest; Claude first pass plus coordinator original-source corrections; model predictions not inspected
blinding: data/validation/self_run_p0_predictions.json, ~/.cache/sisyphus-p0-output and any model output were NOT opened. FRDB snapshot (SHA256 647b80d9...9c7a verified) was used for arm metadata only (sex, n, annotated form, food label). FRDB pk_cmax_value was NOT opened for any arm: no duplicate-dose mapping required it (endoxifen pair ineligible; mephobarbital and laquinimod 0.6 mg pairs have no readable source values).
method_note: AI-assisted pass (3 parallel source-retrieval subagents + coordinator consolidation); not an independent human verifier. Statuses: verified / verified_with_caveat / ineligible / unverified (plus unresolved_arm_mapping, unused here). Eligibility from original full text where accessible; abstracts/regulatory reports used only to record contradictions (ineligible) or context for unverified arms. IR never inferred from oral route alone. Paywall searches time-boxed per coordinator instruction. Coordinator rechecked the strontium patent and laquinimod source claims before any prediction value was inspected. AI review is not independent human verification.
unresolved_issues: Paywalled originals (Wiley/ASCPT, Springer): mephobarbital (Hooper 1990 CPT), cefmatilen (Nakashima 1996 J Infect Chemother), laquinimod DDI (Elgart 2020 CPDD), tolrestat (Troy 1992; van Griensven 1995 CPT). Need institutional/human retrieval.

Mephobarbital: abstract indicates R/S enantiomer kinetics in 4 groups (young/elderly x F/M); racemate parent Cmax may not be reported, and the FRDB F/M rows may not map to a single group even with full text.

Cefmatilen frdb_4607: the only 100 mg Cmax in the abstract (3.78 ug/mL) is explicitly NON-fasting, contradicting the FRDB FASTED label if FRDB used it; dose basis (hydrochloride hydrate vs free acid) unknown.

Laquinimod frdb_6106/6108: four n=14 laquinimod-alone 0.6 mg reference periods exist (keto/fluc/cimetidine/rifampin); mapping and values unresolved. frdb_6104 ineligible from abstract+EPAR only (14-day multiple dose).
Tolrestat frdb_7081: van Griensven 1995 has single and multiple (200 mg BID) phases; single-dose provenance unconfirmed.

IR not explicitly stated for verlukast (compressed tablets), indisetron (film-coated tablets; salt-basis dose), vodobatinib (capsules); coordinator must decide whether non-modified dosage forms count as IR.

Vodobatinib values are Day 1 first-dose values of a 7-day MAD study in healthy men (Table 2, Healthy Subjects); 384 mg n=6 in table vs 7 assigned; PD-patient rows in the same table must not be used. Salt basis not stated.
Indisetron source is a PMDA sponsor application summary (regulatory_summary, not the full study report); dispersion is SE, not SD; dose as hydrochloride salt.

Endoxifen: enteric-coated tablets (ineligible); frdb_10718 E-isomer/female-only row has no source counterpart, likely a mis-annotated duplicate. Full text read via USPTO PGR2025-00043 Exhibit 1011 reproduction of the article.
Diethylpropion: extended-release 75 mg capsule (ineligible); values recorded for audit only.
Strontium lactate patent arm excluded: serum elemental-Sr Cmax and elemental-Sr nominal dose do not meet parent-drug plasma scope.
Laquinimod 1.2 mg study used 14-day dosing, but the cited Cmax timing cannot be established from the accessible abstract; status remains unverified.

candidates.source_identity: Walsh RR, Damle NK, Mandhane S, Piccoli SP, Talluri RS, Love D, Yao SL, Ramanathan V, Hurko O. Plasma and cerebrospinal fluid pharmacokinetics of vodobatinib, a neuroprotective c-Abl tyrosine kinase inhibitor for the treatment of Parkinson's disease. Parkinsonism Relat Disord. 2023;108:105281. doi:10.1016/j.parkreldis.2023.105281. PMID 36717298. Open access (CC BY-NC-ND). Healthy-volunteer data from NCT03445338.
candidates.candidate_notes: All three arms share one design; arm_common applies to each. PD-patient rows at 48/192/384 mg exist in the same table (Day 1 Cmax 964, 1826, 3029 ng/mL) — do NOT map FRDB healthy-male arms to those.

arms.analyte: vodobatinib (parent; validated LC-MS/MS, LLOQ 2.5 ng/mL plasma)

arms.fasting_evidence: "After an overnight fast, participants received once daily doses of vodobatinib as capsules for 7 days."
arms.formulation_evidence: "vodobatinib as capsules"; IR not explicitly stated (Table 2 title: 'vodobatinib capsules')
arms.dose_evidence: Cohorts 48, 192, 384 mg vodobatinib; salt form / free-base basis not stated
arms.single_dose_evidence: Multiple-dose (7-day QD) study; Day 1 Cmax sampled after the FIRST dose (serial samples 0.25–24 h 'after the first dose on Day 1'), i.e., single-dose exposure within a MAD design
arms.reason: Healthy males, fasted, plasma parent Cmax readable. Caveats: (1) Day-1 values from a multiple-dose (MAD) study, not a stand-alone SAD (first-dose PK, pre-accumulation); (2) capsule IR not explicitly stated; (3) dose basis (salt vs free base) not stated; (4) 384 mg cohort: 7 assigned per Methods, N=6 in Table 2; (5) mean type (arithmetic vs geometric) not specified, reported as 'Mean (CV%)'.
